post.summary: Save several system-level values of the same composite policy at once
post.description:
Settings that only make sense together are written as one operation: the policy they belong to validates the resulting configuration before any of them is stored, so the result does not depend on the order of the values.
This endpoint requires admin access

tags.name: external_signing_integrations
tags.description: Administrative OCS boundary for configured external signing integrations. Credentials are write-only. No provider communication or signing occurs here.

tags.name: external_signing_workflow
tags.description: Provider-neutral, signer-facing, experimental external signing API. Signing tokens arrive in POST bodies, never URLs, redirects or query params. Anonymous requests require a verified bound signer code; account signers require Nextcloud CSRF protection in addition to account identity. Session IDs confer no access without independently revalidated identity.
